source_caption:
The emotional chemistry between Andrew Garfield and Emma Stone in The Amazing Spider-Man wasn’t just acting—they actually fell in love during filming. Their real-life relationship quickly became one of Hollywood’s most talked-about romances at the time.

The Amazing Spider-Man (2012), directed by Marc Webb, starring Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone, Rhys Ifans. A fresh and emotional reboot of the Spider-Man story that focuses on Peter Parker’s origins, balancing superhero spectacle with a grounded coming-of-age journey.

source_details.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
source_details.synopsis: The Amazing Spider-Man is a 2012 American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics character Spider-Man. Directed by Marc Webb and written by James Vanderbilt, Alvin Sargent, and Steve Kloves from a story by Vanderbilt, it is a reboot of the Spider-Man film series. It stars Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone, Rhys Ifans, Denis Leary, Campbell Scott, Irrfan Khan, Martin Sheen, and Sally Field. The plot of the film follows the teenager Peter Parker (Garfield) who gains spider-like abilities and fights crime as Spider-Man, while also attempting to live an ordinary life.
